meta.summary: AI spend governed at 2.0x sector median with team envelopes, a 25-retry agent kill switch, and rerouting of shadow subscriptions to approved contracts.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are not reimbursable if an approved equivalent exists on the company allowlist or if the team has already reached its subscription threshold.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope reaches 82% consumed in a billing month
Team envelope reaches 100% consumed with 7 or more days remaining in the month
Company envelope reaches 110% consumed or any agent exceeds kill threshold

rationales.e1: Support team production inference at $211/day runs within the $500/month Support envelope and is correctly scoped to an approved primary provider; no action required.
rationales.e2: Data team nightly embeddings at $38 falls within the $700/month Data envelope and uses an allowlisted provider; batch job passes without intervention.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight with flat volume, breaching the 35% variance band on the Engineering envelope; likely a prompt-length regression or model routing misconfiguration requiring immediate deploy review.
rationales.e4: Marketing has now logged its second ChatGPT Team subscription this quarter, reaching the team_subscription_threshold of 2; this charge is rerouted to the approved OpenAI contract and the employee card transaction is blocked.
rationales.e5: The $4,800 fine-tune request from ML Platform exceeds the $4,000 fine_tune_over_usd threshold and requires Engineering lead approval before the job is queued.
rationales.e6: The Growth team research agent hit 340 retries per hour, exceeding the 25-retry limit, and was burning $47/hr against the $40/hr kill threshold; the loop was terminated, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled spend.
rationales.e7: Growth team frontier exception for the demo build is within the 72-hour window and the incremental cost delta is below the $250 max_delta_usd cap; Engineering lead approval grants a time-boxed routing override.
rationales.e8: A junior engineer personal API key at 22x baseline with no project tag triggers ladder step 2 throttle; spend is paused for 48 hours pending Engineering lead review while attributed experimentation usage under the Engineering envelope is preserved.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent dataset license purchase of $499 falls within the $600 single_txn_ceiling_usd and the data-licensing merchant scope; transaction is approved and logged against the ML Platform envelope.
rationales.e10: The Design team AI video trial at $89/month duplicates a Sales-held tool with 40% seat utilization worth $840 annualized in unused capacity; the trial is rerouted to the existing contract and unused Sales seats are reallocated.
rationales.e11: A $120 charge from an unrecognized inference provider in Engineering triggers the require_approval new_provider_rule; the Engineering lead must complete the vendor security questionnaire before further charges are processed.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged internal-tooling is reclassified from COGS to OpEx per the project_tag rule; the production environment rule does not apply because the workload is not customer-facing.
rationales.e13: Month-to-date spend at 87% of the company envelope with 9 days remaining has crossed the 82% burn_alert_pct threshold; the alert is active and team leads are notified to pace remaining spend, but no throttle is triggered yet.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup complete; all team envelopes reconciled, agent card transactions logged, and classification rules applied with no outstanding policy exceptions.
